sloka: करः च निहतः सम्ख्ये त्रिशिराः च निपातितः ।दूषणः च महा तेजा रामेण विदित आत्मना ॥५-१६-१०॥
transliteration: karaḥ ca nihataḥ samkhye triśirāḥ ca nipātitaḥ ।dūṣaṇaḥ ca mahā tejā rāmeṇa vidita ātmanā ॥5-16-10॥

translations.english: "Ogres like Khara and Trisira and the powerful Dooshana were kileed in battle by Rama endowed with selfknowledge.
